description: Cross-reference matrix mapping regulatory requirements to pipeline operational domains. Strictest standard wins in conflicts.

GLBA.requirement: Safeguards Rule — encryption recommended, not mandated (but FTC treats as best practice)

DOT_FMCSA.requirement: No specific encryption mandate for ELD/HOS data

at_rest.effective_rule: HIPAA — AES-256 at rest for all sensitive documents

ABA_Model_Rules.requirement: Reasonable security for transmitted client data

in_transit.effective_rule: HIPAA — TLS 1.2+ for all sensitive data in transit

HIPAA.requirement: 6 years from creation or last effective date

medical_records.effective_rule: 6 years minimum for medical document data

ABA_Model_Rules.requirement: Varies by state — typically 5-7 years post-representation

client_files.effective_rule: 7 years maximum for legal/financial documents (strictest state bar)

OSHA.requirement: 5 years for 300 logs, 3 years for 301 forms

HIPAA.requirement: 18 PHI identifiers per Safe Harbor method

medical_phi.effective_rule: All 18 HIPAA PHI identifiers must be detected and flagged

GLBA.requirement: Non-public personal information: SSN, account numbers, income, etc.

financial_npi.effective_rule: SSN, financial account numbers, income data must be detected

ABA_Model_Rules.requirement: Client identity information must be protected

client_pii.effective_rule: Client names, contact info, case identifiers must be detected

DOT_FMCSA.requirement: CDL numbers, SSN in DQF files

driver_pii.effective_rule: CDL numbers, SSN, medical certificates for drivers

HIPAA.requirement: Minimum necessary standard for PHI access/sharing

ABA_Model_Rules.requirement: Limit access to client information to what's needed

GLBA.requirement: Collect only information necessary for business purpose

principle.effective_rule: HIPAA minimum necessary standard applied universally

HIPAA.requirement: Notify HHS within 60 days; affected individuals within 60 days; >500 = media notification

medical.effective_rule: 72-hour notification threshold for any PHI breach affecting 500+ individuals

GLBA.requirement: Prompt notification for unauthorized access to NPI

financial.effective_rule: Immediate notification for unauthorized NPI access

HIPAA.requirement: Role-based access, unique user IDs, auto-logoff, audit logs

ABA_Model_Rules.requirement: Supervision of staff handling client data

principle.effective_rule: HIPAA-standard RBAC with audit logging for all pipeline components

strictest_rule_policy.rationale: HIPAA carries the heaviest penalties (up to $1.93M/violation/year) and broadest definition of protected data. Defaulting to HIPAA-level protection covers all other verticals by superset.
